deliverables_scope.text: ny will design and implement a 12 month strategic influencer engagement campaign to strengthen economic ties between the United States and El Salvador by increasing awareness of U.S. investment opportunities, promoting bilateral economic cooperation, and supporting U.S. commercial interests in the country. The cont ractor shall recruit and manage digital influencers to develop Embassy approved content across multiple platforms highlighting the United States as El Salvador’ s preferred economic partner, and will coordinate all logistics for influencer participation in the Foreign Commercial Service fair, including travel arrangeme nts. Deliverables include comprehensive content pack ages for each platform, daily story coverage during the fair, monitoring and analytics following publication, and a full performance report at the conclusion of the campaign, all ex ecuted within the contract period and subject to Embassy approval and funding availability. II. PRICING Category Description Influencer Recruitment and Management Identification, contracting, coordination, and oversight of digital influencers for all campaign activities. Content Creation and Production Development and production of Embassy-approved content across multiple platforms, including reels, TikTok videos,

luding reels, TikTok videos, carousels, static posts, and stories. FCS Fair Participation Support Logistics coordination for influencer participation in the Foreign Commercial Service fair, including travel arrangements and creation of content packages. Monitoring and Analytics Tracking and analysis of content performance after publication, including campaign monitoring and analytics reporting. Final Campaign Reporting Delivery of a comprehensive final performance report summarizing campaign insights, outcomes, and impact.
